title: Consumers prioritize human support over AI in financial services
discussion_signal: The post reports concern that greater AI use could make financial firms less likely to act in customers’ best interests, especially for vulnerable consumers, and emphasizes trust, accessibility, and human support. It directly supports a human-fallback and recourse signal in automated financial services.
linked_research_question: What human fallback, accountability, and recourse do consumers require when financial services use AI?
limits: Research summary rather than full survey data
The post does not show how concern translates into switching or complaints
